decisions.reason: As a feature of the core secure identity platform, its results are likely at or above aspiration and it has no shortfall, so management keeps it.
The identity-bound digital payment wallet is central to the firm's super-app and payment strategy and has not shown a shortfall, so it is retained.
The NFC tag based login authenticator is tied to the firm's authentication expertise, and despite uncertain adoption, organizational slack allows continued evaluation, so keep.
As a dedicated framework presented on its own page, it is considered a strategic asset with no reported shortfall, so keep.
As the flagship platform and focus of the firm's direction, its performance is critical and management would not drop it, with no shortfall indicated.
Application shielding is a core security library with its own page, and no shortfall suggests keeping.
